title: Improve conditional κ to 0.001717256973467 with credited routing-frame fusion
body:
## Change and mathematical scope

The complete twelve-source words in [PR #2751](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/2751) retain the rank-six frame that [PR #2733](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/2733) already refits on a different predecessor word. This contribution composes that credited rank-five refit with **both complete twelve-source words** and passes full finite native, supplier and modern outer admission.

The resulting conditional bound is **κ ≈ 0.001717256973467002308270**, an absolute gain of `0.000000115387118575970161` and a relative gain of **0.006719720697%** over the pinned twelve-source predecessor. This is a small, fully priced improvement; the refit itself is credited work, not a new mechanism.

At B1151, register 515's frame path changes from `5→6→7` to `5→5→7`: two rank-one recursive transports become one rank-two transport. Register 393's paid histogram is unchanged. Across 666 calls the complete delta is `666*(H2−2H1)`, which strictly lowers the moment for `0<a<1`.

- Local profile: `{1:2364,2:647,3:297,4:120,5:26,8:8}`.
- Complete profile: `{1:1591740,2:430902,3:204396,4:79920,5:22532,8:5328,32:1,48:26558}`.
- Rank mass 4,816,512; live/physical stock 66,304/66,801; all 276,390 owner roles, 415 helpers and 72 private buffers remain charged. Scalar chronology, source recovery, arbitrary-input endpoint and cleanup remain unchanged.
- Exact root bracket: `[0.001717256973467002308270, 0.001717256973467002308271]`; κ is the lower endpoint minus `10^-46 + 10^-70`.
- Fixed-word generic packing cap: `<0.001750493235223`; achieved complex endpoint is 98.10132018% of this relaxation cap.

The package retains the pending modern outer and all-size compiler, source-access, hosting/routing, precision/fixed-tape, recovery, BIT and analytic-transfer assumptions. It does **not** discharge the BIT H2 machine obligation or prove an unconditional multiplication theorem. The selected frontier remains unchanged; the larger difference from selected κ includes predecessor work and a different outer contract.

## Task and overlap

Started from canonical main `6b6b3ab304ca60eab7493e73f264fd23c146be4c`, priority revision 5, on `research/routing-leaf-cost`. Refreshed main `936fac15b1b1b59dc5285c713a77f9f3c07b2906` leaves the guidance and selected inputs unchanged. Only `research/complex-routing-leaf-fusion/` is added.

Task card: `scalar-to-moment`; scope **changed** from the explicit routing/leaf request to this binding paid-complex transport. The unchanged complex supplier prevents a faster implementation of the already assumed BIT route/leaf contract alone from improving selected κ. [PR #2399](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/2399) already covers conditional fast-callee substitution; [PR #2457](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/2457) covers spectator padding. This single bounded pivot supplies an actual paid-profile gain.

Exact dependencies:

- [PR #2751](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/2751): `4cfbb0cc8314d7fb4e8e754545a49a42eb590a69`.
- [PR #2733](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/2733): `a63c55ff56aaa8645d64d1162d1f017b59ded42a`.

Final overlap refresh covered 711 open PRs and 1,400 Discussion/comment/reply records, with complete pagination and no warnings. Both dependency heads remained unchanged. `OVERLAP.json` records the boundaries, including the separate [native replay acceleration](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/discussions/2755) and [BIT caller/storage work](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/discussions/2319). Metadata search is not a novelty certificate.

## Validation

```sh
python3.12 -B scripts/research_package.py --package research/complex-routing-leaf-fusion
```

All five registered commands passed in 13.94 seconds on Python 3.12.15 with an unchanged file inventory. They cover complete words, literal forward/dual maps, frames, cleanup, owner allocation, exact moments, packing cap, optimized independent implementations, Git-free replay and rejection controls. Separate source-binding review caught and fixed a stale-bytecode issue in the cap checker; the forged-cache control passes.

Four complete native five-stage chains and retained parent admission were freshly executed. The public full replay then explicitly reused their fully hash-authenticated same-session cache and passed complete supplier/strict outer admission in 196.77 seconds, preserving inherited controls plus the omitted-refit rejection. Exact commands, environments, patches, source manifests, receipts and execution coverage are in `VALIDATION.md` and `evidence/`.

```sh
python3 -m pip install -r research/complex-routing-leaf-fusion/requirements.txt
python3 -B research/complex-routing-leaf-fusion/full_replay.py --work /tmp/FRESH-routing-leaf
```

The one-shot default network-download path was not separately run end to end; the actual invocation used authenticated local source exports and the fresh same-session native cache. No hosted-CI, independent human review or formal verification claim.

## Credit

Mason Hale's assignments, Philippe Van Velzen's pre-life hosting, Jeremy Kothe's allocation, Douglas Colkitt's exact ceiling engine, and the retained native/BIT/outer lineage remain credited. Original source files and notices are retained unchanged. New work is Apache-2.0, prepared for David Arias with substantial OpenAI Codex assistance and separate mathematical and implementation agents.

## Open next questions

The README and TASK.json record two concrete follow-ups: change a source/restoration boundary and price every resulting transport/cleanup/owner cost; or implement one named physical route/leaf boundary with a uniform fixed-tape cost proof. The first targets a larger paid-profile gain; the second targets an inherited theorem obligation. Neither is discharged by this finite composition.
